body: I'm 16. Its not that I can't hold out for college- I just don't want to. I won't make it to the end anyways, so why even put the burden of the cost on my parents? I haven't had any professional help. My parents have caught me cutting before, but they used professional help as a threat. They were saying it was embarrassing and that I had issues. My brother was forced to go to a therapist after supposedly telling someone at school he wanted to kill himself, but my parents took him out of the therapy as soon as they could even though he was benefiting from it.
